items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Lionel Reason told me that Clarence Williams is from Platinum, Louisiana... he's not read about him, he was in the publishing business.

ctx.x: But Lionel Reason told me that, you heard him? Yeah, I know him. Lionel Reason told me that Clarence Williams is from Platinum, Louisiana. Yeah, that's right. And that's only 21 miles from Mookbin.
Where's Lionel Reason from? Platinum, Louisiana. Oh, he's from like that. And Charlie Love is from there. Yeah. Yeah.
